steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Normalize GitHub zip theme folder (…-main) to the canonical stylesheet slug.
$theme_root = get_theme_root();
foreach ( array( 'the-hidden-word-theme', 'the-hidden-word-theme-main' ) as $slug ) {
	$dir = trailingslashit( $theme_root ) . $slug;
	if ( ! is_dir( $dir ) ) {
		continue;
	}
	if ( 'the-hidden-word-theme' !== $slug && ! is_dir( trailingslashit( $theme_root ) . 'the-hidden-word-theme' ) ) {
		@rename( $dir, trailingslashit( $theme_root ) . 'the-hidden-word-theme' );
		$slug = 'the-hidden-word-theme';
	}
	if ( wp_get_theme( $slug )->exists() ) {
		switch_theme( $slug );
	}
	break;
}

wp_set_current_user( 1 );

// Seed curriculum (Playground cron is unreliable).
if ( class_exists( 'HWBL_Activator' ) && method_exists( 'HWBL_Activator', 'process_seed_batch' ) ) {
	for ( $i = 0; $i < 50; $i++ ) {
		if ( get_option( 'hwbl_seeded' ) && false === get_option( 'hwbl_seed_queue', false ) ) {
			break;
		}
		HWBL_Activator::process_seed_batch();
	}
}

// Sample reading plans (needed before Demo Hub / marketing pages that list plans).
if ( class_exists( 'HWBL_Plan_Seed' ) && method_exists( 'HWBL_Plan_Seed', 'maybe_seed' ) ) {
	HWBL_Plan_Seed::maybe_seed();
}

// Full demo pages + sample data (Demo Hub), with Marketing Setup as fallback.
if ( class_exists( 'THW_Demo_Seeder' ) ) {
	if ( method_exists( 'THW_Demo_Seeder', 'drain_curriculum_seed_queue' ) ) {
		THW_Demo_Seeder::drain_curriculum_seed_queue();
	}
	THW_Demo_Seeder::run( true );
} elseif ( class_exists( 'THW_Theme_Marketing_Setup' ) ) {
	THW_Theme_Marketing_Setup::run_setup( true );
	$lesson = get_page_by_path( 'todays-lesson' );
	if ( $lesson instanceof WP_Post ) {
		update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
		update_option( 'page_on_front', (int) $lesson->ID );
	}
}

flush_rewrite_rules( false );
